Sample Pro alert · built from a real scheduled increase (Gemini 4 Argon doubles 2026-12-01)

Subject: Gemini 4 Argon doubles 2026-12-01: your volume +$2,800/mo

  • Your volume: Gemini 4 Argon, 800M input / 120M output tokens a month (0% cache, 0% batch — plug your own mix into the calculator).
  • Today’s run-rate: $2,800/mo ($33,600/yr). From 2026-12-01: $5,600/mo (+$2,800/mo, +$33,600/yr) because the promotional list price doubles.
  • Next 12 months at that volume (Dec 2026–Nov 2027): $67,200 vs run-rate ×12 of $33,600 — the free calculator already shows this; Pro emails the delta when we confirm a change for models you asked us to watch.
  • Google’s published change (ai.google.dev pricing, in our scheduled increases): input $2.00→$4.00, output $10.00→$20.00 per 1M tokens on 2026-12-01. source

The change, figures and Next-12 math are real (from scheduled.json + the calculator engine); the email layout is an example. Cadence is weekly / by hand, matching our methodology — not “within a day.”
